_comment: Tier-2 for febio::heat#8. <NodeSet> with <n id=.../> children gives 'tag "NodeSet" (line N) : invalid value:' with an EMPTY value after the colon, because the element's text content is empty. The fixture regex-matches the message and asserts the tail is empty — that specific detail is what stops a reader thinking the diagnostic was truncated. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
